title: Funding & transparency
lead: Medstudy Academy, z. s. is a Czech nonprofit association (spolek). This page explains how we operate financially and how our activities serve our mission.

sections.heading: Nonprofit status
paragraphs: Registered name: Medstudy Academy, z. s. Company ID (IČO): 06441807. Registered office: Školní 57, Tuchoměřice, Praha-západ, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic.
We are not a commercial education agency. Educational programmes, counselling and community support for beneficiaries are provided free of charge as part of our nonprofit mission.

sections.heading: How we are funded
paragraphs: We currently operate with volunteer work and contributions from partners and supporters that cover operating costs (tools, communication, materials and related expenses).
We have applied for external nonprofit support, including programmes via Goodstack and TechSoup. If awarded, these funds will be used only for free educational and integration programmes.
Any limited commercial activity related to our mission — if introduced later — will be clearly described on this website, with proceeds directed to nonprofit programmes.

sections.heading: What we do not sell
paragraphs: We do not sell paid “guarantees” of university admission, visas, housing or professional licences.
We do not run a commercial online store on this website and we do not host Google AdSense or affiliate advertising networks.
Official decisions always belong to universities, ministries and immigration authorities. Our role is free orientation and nonprofit support.

sections.heading: Annual reports and financial summaries
paragraphs: As a relatively young organisation, we will publish summary financial information and annual reports on this page as they become available under Czech association reporting practice.
Until then, questions about our funding model can be sent to medstudyacademy.cz@gmail.com or via the contact form.
